afc5fd201c69225d.description: About the Role: To manage daily risk mitigation and monitoring for the firm’s credit, collateral, and operational risk portfolios, with a primary focus on margin lending and financing operations. Reporting to the Head of Compliance, this role ensures all trading accounts comply with local regulatory mandates while actively tracking internal process failures, validating manual system entries, enforcing dual controls, and logging operational risk incidents. Responsibilities: 1. Margin & Credit Control Ensure no margin transaction occurs without validating mandatory initial and maintenance margin thresholds. Assess client financial profiles using the internal credit scorecard to assign and review appropriate margin limits. Monitor daily margin usage, block unauthorized limit extensions, and immediately escalate unauthorized breaches to senior management. Verify that margin trading transactions are restricted from unapproved, highly speculative, or derivative financial instruments. 2. Collateral & Liquidation Management Collateral Haircut Reviews: Evaluate eligible stocks to assign Initial Margin ratios and risk groups, ensuring high-risk or "red-colored" stocks are restricted. Concentration Limit Monitoring: Track total credit exposure per stock across all client portfolios to prevent excessive single-stock concentration. Recommend and direct forced liquidations for unsettled margin calls, prioritizing assets systematically from high-risk to higher-quality holdings. 3. Operational Risk & Process Controls Establish processes to assess and mitigate risks associated with new products, services, distribution channels, or system enhancements. Sample test and validate manual entries, correction entries, and account regularizations within core systems. Coordinate with department heads to ensure procedures are updated regularly to include controls for new business processes. Monitor, investigate, and update management on significant reportable events such as incident, complaints, claims, errors, rule breaches, and fraud. 4. Governance & Integrated Reporting Prepare the annual risk assessment plan and recommend policy adjustments in light of the firm's changing risk appetite. Provide continuous risk identification and mitigation support to business lines and department heads. Produce timely, accurate, and meaningful risk exposure dashboards and reports for the Board and Group Risk. Work closely with internal audit and compliance to perform integrated control reviews and track regulatory requirements. Bachelor's Degree in Law, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. Mandatory Certifications: CMA qualifications such as: (CME-1A, CME-1B). Related Work Experience: 3–6 years of experience in credit risk or market risk within a CMA-licensed institution, with specific exposure to margin trading environments. af3d5043ef93a9bd.description: About King Abdullah University of Science and Technology King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) is currently undergoing a Cybersecurity Transformation Program. This initiative focuses on securing cloud and hybrid environments across its multi-cloud infrastructure. The program emphasizes modern security architectures, Zero Trust principles, and sustainable operational handover, involving close collaboration with internal teams and delivery partners to modernize security operations, cloud security posture, identity, and network security. The Role of Cloud Security Engineering Lead KAUST is seeking a hands-on Cloud Security Engineering Lead to design, implement, and assure secure cloud and hybrid environments across its multi-cloud infrastructure. This full-time role combines solution architecture with direct technical execution across various security domains, including cloud security, identity, endpoint, security operations, Zero Trust, and modern workplace security. The incumbent will translate security requirements into deployable technical controls, lead complex implementation activities, resolve cross-platform dependencies, and ensure solutions are operationally supportable and measurable. This role will contribute to multiple portfolio initiatives, including a major project involving Microsoft 365 A5, Enterprise IAM, cloud security posture improvement, security operations integration, network security and segmentation, and cyber exposure reduction. Key Responsibilities Own cloud security architecture and engineering activities for assigned initiatives within the Cybersecurity Transformation Program, from design through implementation, stabilization, and operational handover. Assess Azure, Microsoft 365, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments to identify security gaps, technical dependencies, and opportunities for control improvement. Design and implement secure cloud architectures aligned with KAUST security principles, enterprise architecture standards, operational requirements, and Zero Trust objectives. Provide hands-on engineering across Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management, Identity Protection, MFA and passwordless controls, Intune, Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, and related Microsoft security capabilities. Engineer and improve cloud security posture management, workload protection, attack-path reduction, logging, monitoring, and security configuration across IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, endpoint, and identity environments. Design and implement integrations between cloud platforms and Security Operations, including SIEM/SOAR telemetry, detection use cases, KQL analytics, incident automation, threat intelligence, and operational monitoring requirements. Apply Zero Trust principles across identity, privileged access, endpoints, applications, network access, collaboration, and data, ensuring coherent control operation across cloud and hybrid dependencies. Develop secure connectivity and access patterns for cloud and hybrid environments, collaborating with network security teams on segmentation, firewalling, secure remote access, private connectivity, and DNS. Lead technical design decisions, configuration reviews, proof-of-concept activities, testing, troubleshooting, and remediation for assigned cloud security initiatives. Review and challenge designs proposed by Microsoft, cloud providers, and delivery partners, ensuring technical proposals meet KAUST security, architecture, resilience, logging, and operational standards. Lead or support migration and modernization activities from legacy security platforms to cloud-native capabilities, addressing sequencing, coexistence, rollback, and operational continuity. Manage technical dependencies with Enterprise IAM, Saviynt IGA, Network Security and Segmentation, Cyber Exposure Reduction, Security Operations, endpoint management, infrastructure, and application teams. Contribute technical leadership to the Microsoft 365 A5 project, including architecture, security configuration, Defender, Entra, Intune, Purview, Security Operations integration, Copilot security controls, testing, pilot readiness, and technical handover. Define technical acceptance criteria, validation evidence, security baselines, implementation standards, and production-readiness requirements for assigned initiatives. Proactively identify architecture risks, misconfigurations, security gaps, implementation blockers, and vendor dependencies, driving them to resolution with clear ownership and escalation. Produce high-quality as-built designs, configuration standards, engineering documentation, runbooks, operational procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials. Upskill internal technical teams through pairing, technical walkthroughs, design reviews, troubleshooting, and structured knowledge transfer to ensure sustainable operation of implemented capabilities by KAUST. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Engineering, or a closely related discipline. Substantial equivalent professional experience may be considered. Advanced Microsoft certifications in Azure architecture, security, identity, Microsoft 365 security, or security operations are strongly preferred. Relevant cloud or cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GIAC cloud security, Microsoft Security certifications, Google/AWS security certifications, or equivalent are advantageous. Certifications should support, not substitute for, demonstrable hands-on enterprise cloud security engineering and implementation experience.

af9e2d29922b9794.description: HSE Manager Role Overview DAR ENGINEERING is seeking an experienced HSE Manager to lead Health, Safety, Security, and Environment (HSSE) management for a large-scale program in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time, on-site position reports to the Program Director and is responsible for establishing the HSSE direction, ensuring compliance with Saudi regulations, client requirements, and international standards across all contractors, subcontractors, and consultants. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain the program HSSE plan, policies, and procedures in line with client requirements, applicable Saudi laws and regulations, and internationally recognized standards such as ISO 45001 and ISO 14001. Lead, coach, and develop the HSSE team across the program's projects, setting clear roles, accountabilities, and performance expectations. Set leading and lagging HSSE targets and KPIs, and report performance and risks to program leadership and the client. Review and approve contractors' HSSE plans, method statements, risk assessments, and permit-to-work arrangements before work commences. Monitor HSSE performance during construction through site inspections, audits, and walkthroughs, ensuring timely closure of non-conformances and corrective actions. Integrate HSSE considerations into design reviews, constructability reviews, and planning of construction activities. Ensure compliance with national and international HSSE laws and regulations, and manage permitting processes and interfaces with regulatory and resource agencies. Oversee occupational health and industrial hygiene, environmental compliance and waste management, and site security arrangements, in coordination with the client and contractors. Lead incident and near-miss investigations, root cause analysis, and sharing of lessons learned across the program. Prepare regular HSSE reports, statistics, and dashboards for management and the client, and support internal and external audits. Identify and implement improvements to HSSE systems, processes, and best management practices to minimize impacts during project execution. Qualifications and Experience The ideal candidate will possess deep technical HSSE knowledge and proven leadership experience on large construction programs. Work Environment and Benefits This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with an on-site work arrangement.
